# Franco-Nevada (FNV) and Sandstorm Gold (SAND) Deep Dive Analysis

Report 051 | Published 2021-03-28 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2021-3-28/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/051.json)

Gold royalties, Bitcoin and discount risk.

The GBTC discount boundary and Sandstorm dilution expectation failed, while eventual ETF conversion did bring the discount close to NAV. The Hod Maden schedule failed, distinct from its conditional doubling scenario. Gold new highs and royalty-project concentration warnings were supported.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

- [Sandstorm Q1 2025 results and project update](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1434614/000162828025022732/a991q1-2025sandstormgold.htm) | Sandstorm / SEC | 2025-05-06 | Verified in the audit

Sandstorm maintained a forecast of first Hod Maden production in 2028. Work continued in 2024, but the project had not entered production in the original 2024 window.

## Framework lessons

- Conditional project upside requires a successful trigger.

## Verification limitations

- Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.
- Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
